comments.author: @GlobeDiscovery-NY
comments.text: One cool thing about traveling in Sri Lanka is its double monsoon system. When it's raining heavily on the southwest coast, the east coast around Arugam Bay is completely sunny and dry, so you can literally find good beach weather there all year round if you move with the seasons.

replies.author: @TheGlobalTruth04
replies.text: That’s such a great point! 🇱🇰 One of the amazing things about Sri Lanka is how you can experience completely different weather just by traveling to another part of the island. It really makes the country a special destination to explore throughout the year. Thanks for sharing this useful tip! 🙏🌴
